pipeline: gpt_image_2_5 出一张干净的单体参考图（下方 referencePrompt），1 credit
image_to_3d，should_texture: true，20 credits，得到 5.82 MB GLB
npx @gltf-transform/cli optimize --texture-compress webp --texture-size 768 --compress quantize --simplify true --simplify-ratio 0.45 --simplify-error 0.002 → 869 KB
_meta.whyNotDraco: Draco 能压到 441 KB，但需要额外下载 wasm 解码器；quantize 是 three.js 原生支持的，少一个运行时依赖，换来 428 KB，值得。
_meta.referencePrompt: A single first-century Roman merchant grain ship, isolated on a plain flat neutral mid-grey background, no sea, no sky, no horizon, no ground, no shadow, nothing else in frame. Three-quarter view from slightly above the bow. Broad rounded hull of overlapping tarred planks, high curved sternpost carved into a swan's neck, one heavy mast amidships carrying a furled square mainsail on its yard, a small foremast raked forward over the bow, two side-mounted steering oars at the stern, rope rigging, a deck house aft. Clean even studio lighting, no dramatic shadows, full object visible, centred, entire ship inside the frame. Painted illustration style, muted colours, matte, no text, no watermark.
_meta.shipDetailsFromText: 使徒行传 27:6 的亚历山大粮船、27:16 的小船、27:17 用缆索捆船、27:40 的两支舵桨与船头帆——模型的形制与这些描述不冲突，但经文没有给尺寸，所以这是示意不是复原。
